bullets: attraction follows the alliance graph, not distance
morphology is the visible memory of graph history
subtitle: agents bound to distant partners, not neighbours
summary: Each of 100 000 agents contracts toward the collective centre while being drawn toward one friend and repelled by one enemy - partners chosen anywhere in the population, never by proximity. A deterministic schedule keeps rewiring those relationships, so coherent bodies assemble, shear apart, and reform. The visible morphology is the memory of a hidden, changing graph.
title: NON-LOCAL AFFINITY
